investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC investigation per BOTM-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01: one unauthenticated GET to the venue's official_website (WebFetch/curl fallback), with at most one additional same-origin GET when official_programme_url was directly supplied as a candidate field. No browser, authentication, CAPTCHA bypass, or retry loop.

blockers.description: No events/programme link, ICS feed, JSON-LD event markup, or JSON API endpoint was exposed anywhere in the fetched homepage's static HTML or its internal <a href> links.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated GET to the official homepage returned real body text confirming a live-music identity, but no events/programme page link, feed, or API endpoint was present anywhere in the response to establish a data acquisition path.

reasons: The fetched homepage's own body text directly states 'The Front Room is a premier live music venue in Croydon, programming diverse musical and theatrical performances in an intimate space' and 'a platform for improvised and experimental music & theatre' — this satisfies BeatMapped's music gate on real evidence.

No events/programme link, ICS feed, JSON-LD event markup, or JSON API endpoint was exposed in the static homepage response or its internal navigation links; a plausible first-party acquisition path could not be established from this single bounded GET.
Deeper site navigation (Level 2 structural work) would be required to locate the venue's actual event listing before this candidate could move to READY_FOR_OFFLINE_PROOF.
